response.sql: WITH per_id AS (SELECT ID, AVG(ANA) AS avg_ana FROM Examination WHERE ANA IS NOT NULL GROUP BY ID), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_ana) AS mean_avg_ana FROM per_id) SELECT p.ID, p.avg_ana, p.avg_ana - o.mean_avg_ana AS gap FROM per_id AS p CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE p.avg_ana > o.mean_avg_ana ORDER BY gap DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10;
